central-african-republic.title: Flag of the Central African Republic

colors.note: Top stripe representing the sky and liberty.
Second stripe symbolising peace and dignity.
Third stripe standing for hope and the country's forests.
Bottom stripe and star evoking tolerance and the savannas.
Vertical band crossing all stripes, symbolising the blood shared by humanity.

desc:
- Four equal horizontal bands of blue, white, green and yellow, crossed by a vertical red band
- A yellow five-pointed star appears in the top-left corner on the blue band
- The flag fuses the Pan-African colours with the blue, white and red of the former French colonial power
trivia:
- Designed by Barthélemy Boganda, the founding father of the Central African Republic
- The red band was intended to show that Europeans and Africans share the same blood
- Adopted on 1 December 1958 and retained unchanged after full independence in 1960
